comments.headline: Missing transformer pad clearance dimension callouts
comments.summary: Electrical plan shows five transformer pad locations but does not dimension clearances to adjacent buildings, sidewalks, fire hydrants, fences, or between pads. Access door orientation is not marked, preventing verification of hot-stick use clearances.
comments.attn: Visual analysis of Pads 2 & 3 suggests possible <5-ft clearance to buildings per Run 1, but explicit dimension callouts required for verification.

details.text: Pads 2 and 3 located immediately adjacent to Building 2 and Building 8 with estimated visual clearance of only 2–5 feet, falling short of 5-foot minimum to brick/masonry buildings. No dimensions marked on plan to verify compliance.

runComments.comment: Transformer Pads 2 and 3 are located immediately adjacent to building walls with visual clearance estimated at only 2-5 feet, falling significantly short of the required 5-foot minimum clearance from brick/masonry buildings per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4. No dimensions are marked on the electrical plan to verify clearance compliance.

Specific horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pads to buildings, structures, and building foundations are not shown or dimensioned on the electrical design plan. While five transformer pads are clearly labeled and located, no measurements indicating compliance with minimum 5-foot clearance requirements are provided.

Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan, but specific clearance dimensions from buildings are not labeled. Visual scale analysis suggests some pads may not meet the 5-foot minimum clearance from adjacent buildings, but definitive verification cannot be made without explicit dimension callouts.

details.text: Concrete sidewalks adjacent to some transformer pad locations are shown on site plans, but no dimension callouts verify 2-foot minimum clearance from pad edge to back-of-curb.

runComments.comment: The site plan (Sheet 9) shows concrete sidewalks as part of the site infrastructure, but no sidewalks are explicitly shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) positioned adjacent to transformer pads. The location of site sidewalks relative to each transformer pad cannot be clearly determined from the available plans. Dimensions from pads to nearby sidewalk back-of-curb lines are not marked.
Site plan indicates sidewalks throughout the development, but specific dimensions from transformer pad edges to sidewalk back-of-curb are not shown or dimensioned.
Sidewalks are shown adjacent to some transformer pads on the site plan, but specific dimension callouts showing 2-foot minimum clearance from back of sidewalk are not provided.

details.text: Transformer pad symbols do not indicate access door orientation on any of the five pads, making it impossible to verify 10-foot minimum clearance required for hot-stick operations on the access door side.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not mark or specify access door orientation for any of the five transformer pads, making it impossible to verify that hot-stick use areas have minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent buildings. This is a required documentation element—transformer pad symbols must indicate which side is the access door, and clearance zones must be dimensioned or clearly marked.

Transformer pad locations are shown on the electrical plan, but specific clearance dimensions from the access door side to adjacent buildings or open areas are not provided. Access door orientation is not indicated on the plan.

Transformer pads are shown but access door orientation is not indicated on any pad. No dimension callouts document 10-foot clearance from access door side. Spatial analysis suggests some pads may be constrained by building proximity.

details.text: Fire protection plan (Sheet 10) shows fire hydrant locations and electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads, but no dimensions verify 5-foot minimum clearance between hydrants and pads.

runComments.comment: The fire protection plan (Sheet 10) shows fire hydrant locations on the site, and the electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations, but the two plans do not cross-reference transformer pad positions relative to fire hydrants. No dimensions are marked from any pad to the nearest hydrant. Without explicit distance callouts, compliance with the 5-foot minimum clearance cannot be verified.
Fire Protection Plan shows fire hydrant location on site, but specific dimension callouts between the hydrant and transformer pad locations are not provided.

details.text: Five transformer pads are shown on electrical plan Sheet 21 but no dimension callouts document spacing between adjacent pads, preventing verification of 5-foot minimum clearance.

runComments.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan. Specific clearance dimensions between adjacent transformer pads are not shown or dimensioned on the plans.
Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no dimension callouts show the distances between individual pads. Required 5-foot minimum clearance between pads cannot be verified.

details.text: Where fences or gates are present near transformer pad locations, required clearances (5 feet for sides with access doors/controls, 3 feet for other sides) cannot be verified without documented clearance dimensions or explicit fence location marking on pads.

runComments.comment: No fences or gates are shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) adjacent to transformer pads. The site plan (Sheet 9) does not show fences at transformer pad locations. Without fences shown on the plans, this requirement is not applicable. However, if fences are proposed in the landscape or site plan, the clearance requirements (5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for sides without) must be verified.

Site plan shows various features but no fences or gates are clearly identified as directly adjacent to transformer pad locations. Fence locations and transformer access door orientations are not sufficiently documented to evaluate clearances.

Site plan shows fences and barriers on the property but transformer pads are shown without access door orientation or clearance documentation from fences. Visual analysis suggests some pads are within fenced areas but specific clearances are not dimensioned.

comments.headline: Transformer pads not referenced on landscape, grading, and site coordination plans
comments.summary: Transformer pad locations are shown only on the electrical plan. Landscape plan does not show transformer locations, preventing verification of tree species compatibility, shrub clearances, and root barrier requirements. Grading plan does not show pads relative to retaining walls. Site plan cross-references missing for dumpsters, light poles, and fire lanes.
comments.crossDep: Landscape Design; Grading/Civil Engineering; Site Design
comments.attn: Determine which site features and utilities require cross-reference. Landscape plan must show transformer locations or electrical plan must dimension all landscape clearances.

details.text: Retaining walls shown on grading plan (Sheet 11) but transformer pad locations not depicted there, preventing verification of clearances to walls. Applicability depends on whether any pad is within 5 feet of a retaining wall.

runComments.comment: Retaining walls are shown on the grading plan (Sheet 11) around the site perimeter and pond, but their relationship to transformer pad locations cannot be determined from the plans because (1) transformer pads are not shown on the grading plan, and (2) no clearance dimensions are marked. Applicability depends on whether any pad is located within 5 feet of a retaining wall.

Site plan shows retaining walls on the grading plan (Sheet 11). Specific horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pads to retaining walls are not dimensioned on the electrical or grading plans.

details.text: Dumpster/waste collection locations shown on site plan but no dimension callouts verify 5-foot minimum clearance from transformer pad locations. Dumpster area not cross-referenced on electrical plan.

runComments.comment: Dumpster or waste collection locations are not shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21), and the site plan (Sheet 9) does not clearly indicate whether dumpsters are adjacent to any transformer pad location. Without explicit documentation of dumpster positions and clearance dimensions from transformer pads, this requirement cannot be verified.
Site plan shows dumpster location (trash collection area) but specific dimension callouts between dumpster and transformer pads are not provided.

details.text: Bicycle parking racks detailed on construction detail sheet 22 but transformer pad locations not shown on that sheet, preventing verification of 5-foot minimum clearance.

runComments.comment: Bicycle parking racks are shown on detail sheet 22 (Construction Details 1) with spacing requirements, but no cross-reference is made to transformer pad locations on the electrical plan. Without transformer pads identified on the construction details or with dimensions marked from bike racks to transformer pads, the 5-foot minimum clearance cannot be verified.

details.text: Photometric/site lighting plan not provided in submittal. Light pole locations relative to transformer pads cannot be verified. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be confirmed.

runComments.comment: Light poles are not shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) in relation to transformer pad locations. A photometric plan is referenced in the review guide but not provided in the plan set. Without documentation of light pole positions and dimensions from any transformer pad, the 5-foot minimum clearance requirement cannot be verified.
Site plan shows general lighting requirements and fixtures. Photometric plan was not reviewed. Specific light pole locations relative to transformer pads are not shown or dimensioned.
Photometric plan is not provided in the submittal. Light pole locations cannot be verified relative to transformer pads without site lighting plan.

details.text: Fire protection plan (Sheet 10) designates fire lanes on site, and electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads, but no cross-reference or dimension callouts verify 15-foot minimum clearance from fire lanes.

runComments.comment: The fire protection plan (Sheet 10) designates fire lanes on the site, and the electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations, but no cross-reference or dimensions show whether any pad is within 15 feet of a fire lane. Without marked clearance dimensions or explicit distance callouts, compliance cannot be verified.
Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) was not detailed. Fire lane designations and their proximity to transformer pads cannot be evaluated.
Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) indicates fire lanes are designated on the site. Specific dimension callouts showing 15-foot clearance between fire lanes and transformer pads are not provided.

details.text: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows tree locations and symbols but does not identify species or cross-reference transformer pad locations. Complete species identification and utility-compatibility verification against ECM Appendix F is not confirmed for trees within 10 feet of pads or 15 feet of overhead electric lines.

runComments.comment: The landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not label or identify transformer pad locations, making it impossible to assess whether trees within 10 lateral feet of any pad or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors are present. The landscape plan provides a tree/plant legend but does not cross-reference tree species to transformer locations. Without this cross-reference and without the landscape plan showing transformer pads, the utility-compatibility requirement cannot be verified.

Landscape plan shows overhead electric line (OHE) with trees nearby, and proposed plant species are listed on Sheet 35. However, complete species identification is not confirmed for all trees within 15-foot radius of overhead distribution lines or within 10 feet of transformer pads. Tree species utility-compatibility verification against ECM Appendix F is incomplete.

Landscape plan shows tree locations with symbols (SY, PL, P, M) but does not cross-reference these to transformer pad locations shown on Sheet 21. Without overlay analysis of both plans, tree species utility-compatibility relative to transformer pads cannot be verified.

details.text: Landscape plan shows shrubs/vegetation but does not indicate which plants are adjacent to transformer pads, and transformer access door orientation is not marked. Therefore, 10-foot clearance (access door side) versus 5-foot clearance (other sides) cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: The landscape plan does not depict transformer pad locations, making it impossible to verify the spacing of shrubs or low-lying vegetation relative to transformer access door sides (10 ft minimum) versus other sides (5 ft minimum). Without transformer pads shown on the landscape plan and without dimension callouts from plantings to pad locations, this requirement cannot be verified.

Landscape plan shows general planting areas but specific clearance distances from shrubs and vegetation to transformer pad access doors are not dimensioned. Planting schedule lists shrub species and maximum spacing but does not specify proximity to specific transformer pad access doors.

Landscape plan shows shrubs and vegetation but does not indicate which plants are adjacent to transformer pads. Access door orientation is not marked on transformer pads, so 10-foot vs. 5-foot lateral clearance requirements cannot be determined.

details.text: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations, making it impossible to verify trees within 20 lateral feet of any pad have specified root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment). No root barrier details appear on any landscape sheet.

runComments.comment: The landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show transformer pad locations, and no root barrier details are visible or cross-referenced with transformer locations. Without transformer pads identified on the landscape plan, it is impossible to verify whether trees within 20 lateral feet of any pad have root barriers specified (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment). The landscape plan and electrical plan must be cross-referenced to assess this requirement.
Landscape plan shows tree locations and proposed species. Root barrier details and specifications are not shown on the landscape detail sheets reviewed.

Tree locations are shown on landscape plan but transformer pad locations are not. Cross-reference needed to identify trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment. Root barrier details are not shown on any sheet.

details.text: Transformer pads are located in areas with overhead structures (buildings) and parking areas. No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead obstructions required by UCM § 1.10.3.

runComments.comment: The site plan shows no overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas directly above transformer pad locations. However, no cross-section sheets are provided in the plan set to demonstrate or verify vertical clearances in any access paths. If any pads are located under covered areas, overhangs, or have access paths through structures, cross-sections must be provided. The absence of cross-sections prevents verification of this requirement.
Cross-section drawings are not provided showing vertical clearances in access paths above transformer locations. This is a required survey document for AE Design verification.

Transformer pads are located in areas with overhead structures (buildings), parking garages, and enclosed/landscaped areas. No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead obstructions.

comments.headline: Transformer equipment type and AE Design detail specifications missing
comments.summary: Electrical plan identifies five transformer pad locations but does not reference Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets or specify equipment type (oil-filled versus dry-type). Pad dimensions, service configuration, and utility specifications are not documented.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy Design (must approve transformer pad details); possibly Drainage/Grading (if oil-filled equipment)
comments.attn: Contact AE Design business unit to obtain approved transformer pad detail sheets for the project's service configuration.

details.text: No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are referenced on the electrical plan. Specific pad dimensions (length × width), service type specification (single-phase versus three-phase), and pad design compliance with AE Design standards cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan identifies five transformer pads but does not reference Austin Energy Design-approved pad detail sheets. No pad dimensions (length × width) are shown on the plans, and no service type specification (single-phase vs. three-phase) is identified. Without explicit reference to AE Design-approved transformer pad details and without specification of service type, it is impossible to verify that pad dimensions match AE Design requirements for the applicable service configuration.

Specific transformer pad dimensions are not shown or labeled on the electrical design plan. Service type specification (single-phase vs. three-phase) is not provided on the electrical plan. Without these specifications and without reference to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets, compliance with AE Design pad dimension requirements cannot be verified.

Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no dimensions (length x width) are labeled for any pad. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are referenced or included. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not specified. Pad dimensions cannot be verified against AE Design specifications.

details.text: Electrical plan does not identify whether any transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. This specification is critical because oil-filled equipment triggers 12-foot horizontal clearance to windows/doors/ducts and differential drainage requirements.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not identify whether transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type, which triggers different clearance requirements. Building elevations showing window/door locations and their heights are not provided in the plan set. Without (1) equipment type specification, (2) building elevation drawings, and (3) measured distances from pads to windows/doors, the 12-foot clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

Building elevations and windows/door locations relative to transformer pads were not examined. This requirement applies to oil-filled equipment but transformer type specifications are not provided on the electrical plan.

No information regarding window or door locations relative to transformer pads is provided. Plans do not identify if transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Required 12-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified without building elevation documentation and equipment specifications.

details.text: Equipment type (oil-filled or dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan. Grading plan (Sheet 11) shows general drainage slopes but does not address drainage direction around transformer pad locations. If equipment is oil-filled, drainage must be directed away from buildings, requiring documented drainage callouts on grading plan.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not identify whether transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. The grading plan (Sheet 11) shows general site drainage contours but does not specifically address drainage direction around transformer pad locations or indicate whether pads have level pads or sloped bases. Without equipment type specification and without grading callouts at transformer locations, compliance with the requirement that liquid flow must be away from buildings cannot be verified.

Grading plan (Sheet 11) shows general drainage slopes but does not specify whether transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Transformer specifications are not provided on the electrical plan. Drainage direction relative to building structures from oil-filled equipment cannot be verified without transformer type identification.

No specification is provided identifying whether any transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Grading plan does not show surface flow direction relative to transformer pads. Without equipment specifications and drainage analysis, compliance cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Reduced clearance and confined space exception documentation incomplete
comments.summary: If transformer pads are located less than 5 feet from buildings or in confined spaces/niche configurations, required Austin Energy Design written approval, fire rating specifications, and clearance verification documents are not provided. Applicability depends on pad locations; if not proposed, these items are not applicable.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy Design (must review and approve); Architecture (fire rating documentation, if needed)
comments.attn: Clarify: (1) Are any pads proposed with <5-foot clearance to buildings? (2) Are any niche/confined-space installations proposed? If YES, provide all supporting documentation. If NO, document that finding.

details.text: If Pads 2 or 3 (or others) are intentionally located with <5-foot clearance to buildings, the following are required but not provided: Austin Energy Design written approval; verification that location is not in confined space; documented 10-foot clearance to windows/doors/ducts; documented 15-foot vertical clearance to windows/doors; 3-hour fire-rated material/wall construction documentation.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan shows Pads 2 and 3 with approximately 2-5 feet clearance to buildings, which would trigger the reduced clearance exception if the applicant intends to claim it. However, there is no documentation of (1) Austin Energy Design written approval, (2) verification that location is not in confined space, (3) adequate clearance to windows/doors/ducts (10 ft+ requirement), (4) adequate vertical clearance to windows/doors (15 ft+ requirement), or (5) 3-hour fire rating for the clearance area. Without architectural specifications showing fire ratings or AE Design approval letter, compliance cannot be verified.

Plans do not clearly show whether clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are proposed. No architectural specifications or fire rating documentation is provided to support any reduced clearance approvals.

Plans do not show clearance dimensions between transformer pads and buildings. If any pads are located less than 5 feet from buildings, required AE Design written approval documentation and fire rating verification are not provided in the submittal.

details.text: Electrical plan does not document whether any transformer pad is located in a confined space (niche, vault, or enclosed on 3+ sides). If confined space is proposed, cross-section drawings demonstrating either 35-foot vertical clearance (niche requirement) or clear identification as not confined space are not provided.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not provide cross-sections or detail drawings showing whether any transformer pad is located in a niche, vault, or enclosed area on three or more sides (confined space configuration). Without cross-section drawings demonstrating either 35-foot vertical clearance (if niche) or confirmation that the location is not confined space, the 15-foot versus 10-foot clearance requirement cannot be determined.
No transformer locations are proposed in niches, vaults, or enclosed areas (building footprints). All visible transformer pads appear to be surface-mounted in open site areas.

No cross-section drawings are provided showing whether transformer locations face confined spaces (niches, vaults, or enclosed areas on 3+ sides). Required 35-foot vertical clearance documentation for confined spaces is absent.

details.text: Electrical plan does not indicate whether any transformer pad is proposed in a niche configuration (accessible from outside but within building footprint or notched-out area). If niche service is proposed, no cross-section drawings showing 35-foot minimum vertical clearance or other required clearances are provided.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not indicate whether any transformer pad is located in a niche (accessible from outside but within building footprint), enclosed area, or notched-out building configuration. No cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearances within niche access paths are provided. Without this documentation, the applicability and compliance status of the 35-foot vertical clearance requirement cannot be determined.

details.text: Electrical plan does not identify any niche service installations. No architectural specifications showing 3-hour fire wall ratings are provided in the plan set. No electrical plan notes document consultation with Austin Energy Design regarding niche configurations. If niche service is proposed, fire-wall rating specifications are required.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not identify any niche service installations. No architectural specifications showing 3-hour fire wall ratings are provided in the plan set. No electrical plan notes document consultation with Austin Energy Design business unit regarding niche configurations. Without documentation of niche service proposal and its associated requirements, this item cannot be evaluated.

comments.headline: Building elevation and stair documentation incomplete or not applicable
comments.summary: Compliance with clearance requirements relative to building features (balconies, overhangs, windows, fire escapes) cannot be verified because required architectural documentation is not provided or not applicable to the residential townhome configuration.
comments.crossDep: Architecture (building elevation and floor plan details)
comments.attn: Confirm: (1) Are balconies or building overhangs present above or immediately adjacent to any transformer pad? (2) Are external fire stairs/escapes present adjacent to pads? If YES, provide building elevations and cross-sections. If NO, document explicitly.

details.text: Building elevations showing balcony and overhang locations relative to transformer pad positions are not provided. Requirement applies only when balconies or overhangs are present above or adjacent to transformers. Cross-section or elevation documentation needed to verify compliance or confirm non-applicability.

runComments.comment: No balconies or building overhangs are visible on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) or site plan (Sheet 9) located directly above or immediately adjacent to any of the five transformer pads. The requirement applies only 'when balconies or overhangs are present above or adjacent to transformer.' Building elevations would be needed to confirm whether overhangs extend over pad locations. This cannot be verified from the current plan set.
Building elevations showing balconies and overhangs relative to transformer pad locations were not reviewed. Vertical clearance documentation above transformer pads is not provided.

Building elevations and cross-sections do not show balconies or overhangs directly above or adjacent to transformer pads, but no cross-section drawings are provided to verify vertical clearances or absence of coverings above pads.

details.text: Electrical plan does not identify fire escape or external stairwell locations. Building elevations and floor plans necessary to verify 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance for oil-filled equipment (when fire escapes are present) are not provided. Transformer type specification also missing.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan does not specify whether transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type, and no fire escape locations are identified on the plans. The site plan (Sheet 9) does not show fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes. Building elevations are not provided. Without equipment type specification and without identification of fire escape locations, the 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance requirement cannot be verified.
Building elevations showing fire escape or external stairwell locations were not reviewed. Transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan.

Fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes are not explicitly shown on the site plan. No documentation confirms whether equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Required 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

details.text: No exterior stairwells serving as fire exits are indicated on electrical plan or site plan adjacent to transformer pad locations. For this residential townhome project, exterior emergency stairwells are not typical, suggesting this requirement may not be applicable. Building floor plans would confirm absence of fire stairwells adjacent to any pad.

runComments.comment: No stairwells serving as fire exits are shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) adjacent to transformer pad locations. Building floor plans are not provided in the plan set. The requirement applies only 'when stairwells are present adjacent to transformer.' Without building floor plans showing stair locations, this cannot be verified.
Building floor plans and stairwell locations were not examined. This is a residential townhome project; exterior stairwells serving as fire exits are not typical for this building type.

comments.summary: Water, wastewater, storm drain, gas, and electrical utility lines are shown on various plans but specific clearance dimensions between transformer pads and these utilities are not documented. Electrical routing to meters is not confirmed as 100% on private property. Vertical and horizontal separation requirements are not dimensioned.
comments.crossDep: Water Utility (water/wastewater/storm); Gas Utility (gas lines); Civil Engineering (grading, drainage); Legal (easement routing verification)
comments.attn: Coordinate with all utility providers. Mark clearance dimensions on utility tap plan or provide separate utility coordination matrix with minimum distances for each utility type.

details.text: Utility tap plan (Sheet 19) shows water line routing and electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads, but no dimension callouts or cross-sections verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance from water lines to any transformer pad.

runComments.comment: The utility tap plan (Sheet 19) shows water line routing for the site, and the electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations, but no cross-reference or dimensions show the clearance between any transformer pad and the water line. Without marked clearance dimensions or documented analysis of separation distances, compliance with the 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.
Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows water line routing but specific clearance dimensions between transformer pads and water lines are not shown or dimensioned.

Water lines are shown on both electrical plan (Sheet 21) and utility plan (Sheet 19) relative to transformer pads, but specific dimension callouts documenting 5-foot horizontal clearance are not provided.

Without marked clearance dimensions, compliance with the 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.
Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows wastewater line routing but specific clearance dimensions between transformer pads and wastewater lines are not shown or dimensioned.
Wastewater lines are shown on both electrical and utility plans relative to transformer pads, but specific dimension callouts documenting 5-foot horizontal clearance are not provided.

details.text: Storm sewer plan (Sheet 12) shows storm drain line routing and electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads, but no dimension callouts verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance between pads and storm drain lines.

runComments.comment: The storm sewer plan (Sheet 12) shows storm drain line routing, and the electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations, but no cross-reference or dimensions show the clearance between any transformer pad and the storm drain line. Storm Sewer Plan (Sheet 12) shows storm drain line routing but specific clearance dimensions between transformer pads and storm drain lines are not shown or dimensioned.
Storm drain lines are shown on electrical plan and storm sewer plan relative to transformer pads, but specific dimension callouts documenting 5-foot horizontal clearance are not provided.

details.text: Multiple utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric conduit) are shown near transformer pads on various plans, but no cross-sections or dimension callouts document the required 12-inch minimum separation (both horizontal and vertical, outside diameter to outside diameter) between transformer facilities and other underground utilities.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan shows transformer pad locations, and the utility tap plan shows various utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, and references to electric conduit), but no cross-sections or dimension callouts show the vertical and horizontal separations between transformer pads and other underground utilities. The minimum 12-inch clearance requirement (both horizontal and vertical, outside diameter to outside diameter) cannot be verified without marked dimensions or cross-sections.

Multiple utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric) are shown on the electrical plan near transformer pads, but specific horizontal and vertical clearance dimensions (12-inch minimum) are not callout on any sheet.

details.text: Electrical plan and site plan show transformer locations and building footprints, but no documentation confirms that no customer buildings, parking garages, foundations, or structures are installed over Austin Energy underground facilities. Cross-sections or utilities coordination analysis are not provided.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan shows transformer pad locations, and the site plan shows building footprints, but no cross-sections or analysis documents whether transformer locations are positioned above, below, or near other utility lines, or whether any building foundations are constructed over Austin Energy underground facilities. Without cross-sections or documented utility coordination, this requirement cannot be verified.

Plans do not show architectural details or cross-sections depicting foundations, slabs, or underground structures relative to utility lines and transformer locations. Conflict verification documentation is not provided.

Transformer pads and AE underground facilities are shown on the electrical plan, but no analysis or documentation is provided confirming that no customer buildings, parking garages, foundations, or structures are installed over AE underground facilities.

details.text: Gas service infrastructure, pressure specifications, and line routing are not clearly shown on electrical or utility plans. Specific gas line locations relative to transformer pads and required clearances cannot be evaluated.

runComments.comment: Gas service infrastructure and pressure specifications are not clearly shown on the electrical or utility plans reviewed. Specific gas line locations relative to transformer pads cannot be evaluated.

details.text: Electrical routing from transformer pads to service meters is shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) with underground lines indicated, but no explicit notation or dimension callouts verify that all conduit/cable routing is 100% on private property. Vision analysis indicates potential routing through a wastewater easement.

runComments.comment: The electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations and references underground electric lines but does not clearly depict the complete routing of conduits/cables from each transformer pad to associated meters or service disconnects. The plat does not show electrical routing or confirm that routing is 100% on private property. Without explicit documentation of electrical routing paths and their location on private property, this requirement cannot be verified.

Electrical routing must be 100% on private property. Routing through an easement violates this requirement unless easement routing is approved by the utility holding the easement.

Electrical routing from transformers to meters is shown on the electrical plan with underground lines indicated, but no explicit notation or dimension callouts verify that all routing is 100% on private property and does not enter public right-of-way.

comments.headline: Transformer locations not shown on plat; overhead utilities and easement conflicts not documented
comments.summary: Transformer pads are shown only on electrical plan, not on the property plat, preventing verification that all pads are on private property and not straddling property lines. At least one pad intersects recorded easements. Required transformer easements for AE Design access are not shown. Overhead utility routing and clearances are not documented.
comments.crossDep: Survey/Property (must verify easements and private property status); Austin Energy Design (must approve easement conflicts); Legal (if easement rights required)
comments.attn: CRITICAL: (1) Show all five transformer pad locations on the plat (Sheet 2) with dimensions to property lines. (2) Verify and document that ALL pads are 100% on private property. (3) If any pad intersects a recorded easement, obtain written Austin Energy Design approval per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4. (4) Show transformer easements (with dimensions and widths) on plat for AE Design access per UCM § 1.10.3.

details.text: Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but NOT depicted on property plat (Sheet 2) in relation to property lines, easements, or public right-of-way. This prevents verification that all five pads are 100% on private property and do not straddle property lines.

runComments.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) but are NOT depicted on the plat (Sheet 2). Because transformer pad locations are not shown on the plat in relation to property lines, easements, or public right-of-way, it is impossible to verify that all five pads are 100% on private property and not in public right-of-way or straddling property lines. This is a critical documentation gap—transformer locations must be shown on the plat with confirmation of private property location.

details.text: Vision analysis confirms at least one transformer pad (east of Units 404/504, between Buildings 4–5) is located within or intersects recorded easements: '25' Drainage Easement' (Doc. 2011021707) and 'Existing 15' Wastewater Easement' (Vol. 73, Pg. 76). Transformer pads cannot be located in drainage, water, sewer, or electrical easements under overhead lines without written Austin Energy Design approval. No such approval is documented.

runComments.comment: The plat (Sheet 2) identifies several easements including drainage, utility, and wastewater easements across the site. comments.headline: Required bollard protection not shown for transformer pads near parking
comments.summary: All five transformer pads are located within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle circulation routes. Required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal post bollards for vehicle impact protection per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 are not shown or specified anywhere on electrical plan or detail sheets.
comments.crossDep: Site Design (parking layout); Architectural Details (bollard detail standardization)

details.text: All five transformer pads are located immediately adjacent to (within 4 feet of) parking areas and vehicle circulation routes. No bollard protection symbols are shown on electrical plan or detail sheets. Four-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts must be installed per AE Design equipment pad details referenced in UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4. Bollard locations, spacing, and detail references must be added to the electrical plan.

runComments.comment: All five transformer pads are located immediately adjacent to (within 4 feet of) parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes. However, no bollards (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts) are shown or specified anywhere on the electrical plan or detail sheets. No detail drawing reference is provided for bollard installation per AE Design equipment pad details. This represents a violation of UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4, which requires bollards when pads are within 4 feet of parking/vehicle areas.

Vision analysis confirms that at least two transformer pads are located immediately adjacent to (within 4 feet of) parking areas and drive aisles: (1) west of Building 1, near the curved drive entrance, and (2) between Buildings 6 and 7, adjacent to the internal east-west drive aisle. Per the plans reviewed, no bollards are shown to protect these transformer pads. 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts are required where pads are within 4 feet of parking/vehicle circulation routes per AE Design equipment pad details.
